mapper.select: SELECT s.SHIP_NO, s.WH_CD, s.SHIPPER_CD, s.SHIP_DATE, s.STATUS, w.WH_NM, sh.SHIPPER_NM FROM SHIP_HDR s JOIN WAREHOUSE w ON s.WH_CD = w.WH_CD JOIN SHIPPER sh ON s.SHIPPER_CD = sh.SHIPPER_CD ORDER BY s.SHIP_NO DESC

SELECT s.SHIP_NO, s.WH_CD, s.SHIPPER_CD, s.SHIP_DATE, s.STATUS, w.WH_NM, sh.SHIPPER_NM FROM SHIP_HDR s JOIN WAREHOUSE w ON s.WH_CD = w.WH_CD JOIN SHIPPER sh ON s.SHIPPER_CD = sh.SHIPPER_CD WHERE s.SHIP_NO = #{shipNo}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO SHIP_HDR (SHIP_NO, WH_CD, SHIPPER_CD, SHIP_DATE, STATUS) VALUES (#{shipNo}, #{whCd}, #{shipperCd}, #{shipDate}, #{status})
